articles.title_en: Target PCA: Transfer learning large dimensional panel data
articles.title_cn: 目标主成分分析：大维度面板数据的迁移学习
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a novel method to estimate a latent factor model for a large target panel with missing observations by optimally using the information from auxiliary panel data sets. We refer to our estimator as target-PCA. Transfer learning from auxiliary panel data allows us to deal with a large fraction of missing observations and weak signals in the target panel. We show that our estimator is more efficient and can consistently estimate weak factors, which are not identifiable with conventional methods. We provide the asymptotic inferential theory for target-PCA under very general assumptions on the approximate factor model and missing patterns. In an empirical study of imputing data in a mixed-frequency macroeconomic panel, we demonstrate that target-PCA significantly outperforms all benchmark methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种新方法，通过最优利用辅助面板数据集的信息，来估计具有缺失观测值的大目标面板的潜在因子模型。我们将我们的估计器称为目标主成分分析。从辅助面板数据进行迁移学习使我们能够处理目标面板中大量缺失观测值和弱信号。我们表明，我们的估计器更有效，并且能够一致地估计弱因子，而这些弱因子使用传统方法无法识别。我们在近似因子模型和缺失模式的非常一般的假设下，提供了目标主成分分析的渐近推断理论。在对混合频率宏观经济面板数据插补的实证研究中，我们证明了目标主成分分析显著优于所有基准方法。

articles.abstract_en: Do state-dependent local projections asymptotically recover the population responses of macroeconomic aggregates to structural shocks? The answer to this question depends on how the state of the economy is determined and on the magnitude of the shocks. When the state is exogenous, the local projection estimator recovers the population response regardless of the shock size. When the state depends on macroeconomic shocks, as is common in empirical work, local projections only recover the conditional response to an infinitesimal shock, but not the responses to larger shocks of interest in many applications. Simulations suggest that impulse responses may be off by as much as 82 percent and fiscal multipliers by as much as 40 percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 状态依赖的局部投影能否渐近地恢复宏观经济总量对结构性冲击的总体响应？这个问题的答案取决于经济状态是如何确定的以及冲击的大小。当状态是外生的时，局部投影估计量无论冲击大小如何都能恢复总体响应。当状态依赖于宏观经济冲击时（这在实证工作中很常见），局部投影只能恢复无穷小冲击的条件响应，而不能恢复许多应用中感兴趣的大冲击的响应。模拟表明，脉冲响应可能偏差高达82%，财政乘数可能偏差高达40%。

articles.title_cn: 不稳定环境下的局部投影
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a local projection estimator for estimating impulse responses in the presence of time variation. Importantly, we allow local instabilities in both slope coefficients and variances. Monte Carlo simulations illustrate that the method performs well in practice. Using our proposed estimator, we shed new light on the effects of fiscal policy shocks and the size of government spending multipliers. Our analysis uncovers the existence of instabilities that were unaccounted for in previous studies, and links time variation in the multipliers to the size of government debt.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在存在时变性的情况下，开发了一种用于估计脉冲响应的局部投影估计量。重要的是，我们允许斜率系数和方差都存在局部不稳定性。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该方法在实践中表现良好。使用我们提出的估计量，我们对财政政策冲击的影响和政府支出乘数的大小有了新的认识。我们的分析揭示了先前研究中未考虑的不稳定性的存在，并将乘数的时间变化与政府债务规模联系起来。

articles.title_en: Reprint of: Robust inference on correlation under general heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 重印：一般异质性下的相关性稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: Considerable evidence in past research shows size distortion in standard tests for zero autocorrelation or zero cross-correlation when time series are not independent identically distributed random variables, pointing to the need for more robust procedures. Recent tests for serial correlation and cross-correlation in Dalla, Giraitis, and Phillips (2022) provide a more robust approach, allowing for heteroskedasticity and dependence in uncorrelated data under restrictions that require a smooth, slowly-evolving deterministic heteroskedasticity process. The present work removes those restrictions and validates the robust testing methodology for a wider class of innovations and regression residuals allowing for heteroscedastic uncorrelated and non-stationary data settings. The updated analysis given here enables more extensive use of the methodology in practical applications. Monte Carlo experiments confirm excellent finite sample performance of the robust test procedures even for extremely complex white noise processes. The empirical examples show that use of robust testing methods can materially reduce spurious evidence of correlations found by standard testing procedures.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去研究中的大量证据表明，当时间序列不是独立同分布随机变量时，标准检验在零自相关或零互相关检验中存在规模失真，这表明需要更稳健的程序。Dalla、Giraitis和Phillips（2022）最近提出的序列相关和互相关检验提供了一种更稳健的方法，允许不相关数据中存在异方差性和依赖性，但需满足要求平滑、缓慢演变的确定性异方差过程的限制。本研究去除了这些限制，并验证了稳健检验方法适用于更广泛的创新和回归残差类别，允许异方差不相关和非平稳数据设置。这里给出的更新分析使得该方法在实际应用中得到更广泛的使用。蒙特卡洛实验证实，即使对于极其复杂的白噪声过程，稳健检验程序也具有出色的有限样本性能。实证例子表明，使用稳健检验方法可以显著减少标准检验程序发现的虚假相关性证据。

articles.title_en: Reprint of: The likelihood ratio test for structural changes in factor models
articles.title_cn: 转载：因子模型中结构变化的似然比检验
articles.abstract_en: A factor model with a break in its factor loadings is observationally equivalent to a model without changes in the loadings but with a change in the variance of its factors. This approach effectively transforms a high-dimensional structural change problem into a low-dimensional problem. This paper considers the likelihood ratio (LR) test for a variance change in the estimated factors. The LR test implicitly explores a special feature of the estimated factors: the pre-break and post-break variances can be a singular matrix under the alternative hypothesis, making the LR test diverging faster and thus more powerful than Wald-type tests. The better power property of the LR test is also confirmed by simulations. We also consider mean changes and multiple breaks. We apply this procedure to the factor modeling of the US employment and study the structural change problem using monthly industry-level data.
articles.abstract_cn: 因子载荷存在断点的因子模型在观测上等价于载荷无变化但因子方差发生变化的模型。这种方法有效地将高维结构变化问题转化为低维问题。本文考虑了针对估计因子方差变化的似然比（LR）检验。LR检验隐含地探索了估计因子的一个特殊特征：在备择假设下，断点前和断点后的方差可以是奇异矩阵，这使得LR检验发散更快，因此比Wald型检验更有效。LR检验更好的功效性质也通过模拟得到了证实。我们还考虑了均值变化和多重断点。我们将此程序应用于美国就业的因子建模，并使用月度行业层面数据研究结构变化问题。

articles.title_en: Reprint of: Out-of-sample tests for conditional quantile coverage: An application to Growth-at-Risk
articles.title_cn: 重印：条件分位数覆盖率的样本外检验——在增长风险中的应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes tests for out-of-sample comparisons of interval forecasts based on parametric conditional quantile models. The tests rank the distance between actual and nominal conditional coverage with respect to the set of conditioning variables from all models, for a given loss function. We propose a pairwise test to compare two models for a single predictive interval. The set-up is then extended to a comparison across multiple models and/or intervals. The limiting distribution varies depending on whether models are strictly non-nested or overlapping. In the latter case, degeneracy may occur. We establish the asymptotic validity of wild bootstrap based critical values across all cases. An empirical application to Growth-at-Risk (GaR) uncovers situations in which a richer set of financial indicators are found to outperform a commonly-used benchmark model when predicting downside risk to economic activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了基于参数条件分位数模型的区间预测样本外比较检验。这些检验针对给定的损失函数，根据所有模型的条件变量集，对实际条件覆盖率与名义条件覆盖率之间的距离进行排序。我们提出了一种成对检验，用于比较两个模型的单一预测区间。该设置随后扩展到多个模型和/或区间的比较。极限分布根据模型是严格非嵌套还是重叠而有所不同。在后一种情况下，可能出现退化。我们建立了野生自助法临界值在所有情况下的渐近有效性。对增长风险（GaR）的实证应用揭示了在某些情况下，更丰富的金融指标集在预测经济活动下行风险时优于常用基准模型。

articles.title_en: Vector autoregressions with dynamic factor coefficients and conditionally heteroskedastic errors
articles.title_cn: 具有动态因子系数和条件异方差误差的向量自回归
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a new and general methodology for analyzing vector autoregressive models with time-varying coefficient matrices and conditionally heteroskedastic disturbances. The proposed approach is transparent and simple to implement. It allows the derivation of well-defined impulse response functions that rely on the overall stability of the system. We present the finite sample properties of the model in a simulation study. In an empirical illustration we investigate the possibly time-varying relationships between U.S. industrial production, inflation, and bond spread. We empirically identify a time-varying linkage between economic and financial variables which are effectively described by a common dynamic factor. The impulse response analysis identifies substantial differences in the effects of financial shocks on output and inflation during crisis and non-crisis periods. The results also illustrate how the widely-used approach of fixing the VAR coefficients in the derivation of the impulse responses leads to a sizeable underestimation of the impact of a financial shock on output and inflation during some of the crises in our sample.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种新的通用方法，用于分析具有时变系数矩阵和条件异方差扰动的向量自回归模型。所提出的方法透明且易于实施。它允许推导出依赖于系统整体稳定性的定义良好的脉冲响应函数。我们在模拟研究中展示了模型的有限样本性质。在一个实证示例中，我们调查了美国工业生产、通货膨胀和债券利差之间可能存在的时变关系。我们实证识别出经济变量与金融变量之间的时变联系，这些联系有效地由一个共同的动态因子描述。脉冲响应分析识别出在危机和非危机时期，金融冲击对产出和通货膨胀的影响存在显著差异。结果还说明了广泛使用的在推导脉冲响应时固定VAR系数的方法，如何导致在我们样本中的某些危机期间，金融冲击对产出和通货膨胀的影响被大幅低估。

articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new class of time series models, the functional quantile autoregression (FQAR) models, in which the conditional distribution of the observation at the current time point is affected by its past distributional information, and is expressed as a functional of the past conditional quantile functions. Different from the conventional functional time series models which are based on functionally observed data, the proposed FQAR method studies functional dynamics in traditional time series data. We propose a sieve estimator for the model. Asymptotic properties of the estimators are derived. Numerical investigations are conducted to highlight the proposed method.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一类新的时间序列模型，即函数分位数自回归（FQAR）模型，其中当前时间点观测值的条件分布受其过去分布信息的影响，并表示为过去条件分位数函数的函数。与基于函数型观测数据的传统函数型时间序列模型不同，所提出的FQAR方法研究传统时间序列数据中的函数动态。我们为该模型提出了一个筛子估计量。推导了估计量的渐近性质。进行了数值研究以突出所提出的方法。

articles.title_en: Some fixed-b results for regressions with high frequency data over long spans
articles.title_cn: 长期跨度高频数据回归的固定b结果
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops fixed-b asymptotic results for heteroskedasticity autocorrelation robust (HAR) Wald tests for high frequency data using the continuous time framework of Chang et al. (2023) (CLP). It is shown that the fixed-b limit of HAR Wald tests for high frequency stationary regressions is the same as the standard fixed-b limit in Kiefer and Vogelsang (2005). For the case of cointegrating regression the form of the fixed-b limits are different from the stationary case and may or may not be pivotal but also have the same fixed-b limits that have been obtained for tests based on ordinary least squares (OLS) (Bunzel, 2006) and integrated modified OLS (Vogelsang and Wagner, 2014). A simulation study shows that fixed-b critical values provide rejection probabilities closer to nominal levels than traditional chi-square critical values when using data-dependent bandwidths. The Andrews (1991) data-dependent method works reasonably well for a wider range of persistence parameters than those considered by CLP. In contrast, the Newey and West (1994) data-dependent method is sensitive to the choice of pre-tuning parameters. The data-dependent method of Sun et al. (2008) give results similar to the Andrews (1991) method with slightly less over-rejection problems when used with fixed-b critical values. Our results for bandwidth choice reinforce the importance of high frequency compatibility of bandwidths as emphasized by CLP. Regardless of the bandwidth method used in practice, it is clear that fixed-b critical values can and should be used for high frequency data whenever HAR tests are based on kernel estimators of long run variances. Our results complement the analysis of Pellatt and Sun (2023) who focused on HAR tests based on orthonormal series estimators of long run variance estimator.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于Chang等人（2023）（CLP）的连续时间框架，为高频数据的异方差自相关稳健（HAR）Wald检验发展了固定b渐近结果。研究表明，高频平稳回归的HAR Wald检验的固定b极限与Kiefer和Vogelsang（2005）中的标准固定b极限相同。对于协整回归的情况，固定b极限的形式与平稳情况不同，可能具有也可能不具有枢轴性，但也具有与基于普通最小二乘（OLS）（Bunzel，2006）和修正OLS（Vogelsang和Wagner，2014）的检验所获得的相同固定b极限。模拟研究表明，当使用数据依赖带宽时，固定b临界值提供的拒绝概率比传统卡方临界值更接近名义水平。Andrews（1991）的数据依赖方法在比CLP考虑的更广泛的持久性参数范围内表现良好。相比之下，Newey和West（1994）的数据依赖方法对预调参数的选择敏感。Sun等人（2008）的数据依赖方法给出的结果与Andrews（1991）方法相似，但在使用固定b临界值时略微减少了过度拒绝问题。我们关于带宽选择的结果强化了CLP所强调的带宽高频兼容性的重要性。无论实践中使用何种带宽方法，很明显，只要HAR检验基于长期方差的核估计量，固定b临界值就可以且应该用于高频数据。我们的结果补充了Pellatt和Sun（2023）的分析，他们专注于基于长期方差估计量的正交序列估计量的HAR检验。

articles.title_en: Scenario-based quantile connectedness of the U.S. interbank liquidity risk network
articles.title_cn: 基于情景的美国银行间流动性风险网络分位数关联性
articles.abstract_en: We characterize the U.S. interbank liquidity risk network based on a supervisory dataset, using a scenario-based quantile network connectedness approach. In terms of methodology, we consider a quantile vector autoregressive model with unobserved heterogeneity and propose a Bayesian nuclear norm estimation method. A common factor structure is employed to deal with unobserved heterogeneity that may exhibit endogeneity within the network. Then we develop a scenario-based quantile network connectedness framework by accommodating various economic scenarios, through a scenario-based moving average expression of the model where forecast error variance decomposition under a future pre-specified scenario is derived. The methodology is used to study the quantile-dependent liquidity risk network among large U.S. bank holding companies. The estimated quantile liquidity risk network connectedness measures could be useful for bank supervision and financial stability monitoring by providing leading indicators of the system-wide liquidity risk connectedness not only at the median but also at the tails or even under a pre-specified scenario. The measures also help identify systemically important banks and vulnerable banks in the liquidity risk transmission of the U.S. banking system.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于监管数据集，采用基于情景的分位数网络关联性方法，刻画了美国银行间流动性风险网络。在方法论上，我们考虑了一个具有未观测异质性的分位数向量自回归模型，并提出了一种贝叶斯核范数估计方法。采用共同因子结构来处理可能在网络内表现出内生性的未观测异质性。然后，我们通过模型的情景化移动平均表达，推导出未来预设情景下的预测误差方差分解，从而构建了基于情景的分位数网络关联性框架。该方法被用于研究大型美国银行控股公司之间的分位数依赖流动性风险网络。估计的分位数流动性风险网络关联性指标不仅在中位数处，而且在尾部甚至预设情景下，都能提供系统性流动性风险关联性的先行指标，有助于银行监管和金融稳定监测。这些指标还有助于识别美国银行体系中流动性风险传导中的系统重要性银行和脆弱银行。

articles.title_en: Specification tests for non-Gaussian structural vector autoregressions
articles.title_cn: 非高斯结构向量自回归的设定检验
articles.abstract_en: We propose specification tests for independent component analysis and structural vector autoregressions that assess the cross-sectional independence of non-Gaussian shocks by comparing their joint cumulative distribution with the product of their marginals at both discrete and continuous grids of argument values, the latter yielding a consistent test. We explicitly consider the sampling variability from computing the shocks using consistent estimators. We study the finite sample size of resampled versions of our tests in simulation exercises and show their non-negligible power against a variety of empirically plausible alternatives. Finally, we apply them to a dynamic model for three popular volatility indices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了针对独立成分分析和结构向量自回归的设定检验，通过比较非高斯冲击的联合累积分布与其边缘分布乘积在离散和连续参数网格上的差异来评估冲击的横截面独立性，其中连续网格产生一致检验。我们明确考虑了使用一致估计量计算冲击时的抽样变异性。我们在模拟练习中研究了重采样版本检验的有限样本大小，并展示了它们对多种经验上合理的备择假设具有不可忽略的功效。最后，我们将它们应用于一个包含三个流行波动率指数的动态模型。

articles.title_en: Estimation of continuous-time linear DSGE models from discrete-time measurements
articles.title_cn: 从离散时间测量中估计连续时间线性DSGE模型
articles.abstract_en: We provide a general state space framework for estimation of the parameters of continuous-time linear DSGE models from discrete-time data. Our approach relies on the exact discrete-time representation of the equilibrium dynamics, hence avoiding discretization errors. We construct the exact likelihood for data sampled either as stocks or flows, based on the Kalman filter, and provide necessary and sufficient conditions for local identification of the frequency-invariant structural parameters of the underlying continuous-time model. We recover the unobserved structural shocks at measurement times from the reduced-form residuals in the state space representation by exploiting the underlying causal links implied by the economic model. We illustrate our approach using an off-the-shelf real business cycle model. Extensive Monte Carlo experiments show that the finite sample properties of our estimator are superior to those of an estimator relying on a naive Euler–Maruyama discretization of the economic model. In an application to postwar U.S. macroeconomic data, we estimate the model using series sampled at mixed frequencies, and combinations of series sampled as stocks and flows, and we provide a historical decomposition of the effects of shocks on observables into those stemming from structural supply and demand shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个通用的状态空间框架，用于从离散时间数据中估计连续时间线性DSGE模型的参数。我们的方法依赖于均衡动力学的精确离散时间表示，从而避免了离散化误差。我们基于卡尔曼滤波器，为以存量或流量形式采样的数据构建了精确似然函数，并提供了底层连续时间模型的频率不变结构参数局部识别的必要和充分条件。我们通过利用经济模型隐含的底层因果联系，从状态空间表示中的简化形式残差中恢复测量时间点的未观测结构冲击。我们使用一个现成的实际经济周期模型来说明我们的方法。广泛的蒙特卡洛实验表明，我们估计量的有限样本性质优于依赖朴素欧拉-丸山离散化经济模型的估计量。在对战后美国宏观经济数据的应用中，我们使用混合频率采样的序列以及存量与流量组合采样的序列来估计模型，并提供了冲击对可观测变量影响的历史分解，将其分解为结构性供给和需求冲击的影响。

articles.title_en: Local projections vs. VARs: Lessons from thousands of DGPs
articles.title_cn: 局部投影与VAR：来自数千个DGP的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a simulation study of Local Projection (LP) and Vector Autoregression (VAR) estimators of structural impulse responses across thousands of data generating processes, designed to mimic the properties of the universe of U.S. macroeconomic data. Our analysis considers various identification schemes and several variants of LP and VAR estimators, employing bias correction, shrinkage, or model averaging. A clear bias–variance trade-off emerges: LP estimators have lower bias than VAR estimators, but they also have substantially higher variance at intermediate and long horizons. Bias-corrected LP is the preferred method if and only if the researcher overwhelmingly prioritizes bias. For researchers who also care about precision, VAR methods are the most attractive—Bayesian VARs at short and long horizons, and least-squares VARs at intermediate and long horizons.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项模拟研究，比较了局部投影（LP）和向量自回归（VAR）估计量在数千个数据生成过程中的结构脉冲响应，这些过程旨在模仿美国宏观经济数据总体的特性。我们的分析考虑了多种识别方案以及LP和VAR估计量的几种变体，采用了偏差校正、收缩或模型平均。一个清晰的偏差-方差权衡出现了：LP估计量比VAR估计量具有更低的偏差，但在中期和长期视野中，它们的方差也显著更高。当且仅当研究者极度优先考虑偏差时，偏差校正的LP是首选方法。对于也关注精度的研究者，VAR方法最具吸引力——在短期和长期视野中为贝叶斯VAR，在中期和长期视野中为最小二乘VAR。

excluded_items.title_en: Introduction to the Themed Issue: Macroeconometrics
